reason: Value lens fails: the realistic public gain is about +0.0002 (range 0..+0.0005), 4-15x below the +0.002 bar and far inside the 0.003 LB noise. Recomputed ceiling: D = 122,151+6,846+6,732 = 135,729, so 1 FN edge = 7.37e-6 (fn_anatomy_exp39.md). All 44b6 a_never (167) = +0.0012. All 6bba a_never (1,740) = +0.0128. The idea's '+0.0039 if 30% of 6bba' checks out, but it is a count before capture and before node cost. Four points cut it further. (1) The shoulder share is unmeasured, and the cited evidence does not support 'shoulder'. r2_critic l.16 measured on only 25/63 placeable 44b6 clips that a_never GT has an Ultrack object at 2.3 um while our node sits on another object ~7 um away. 'z-blurred shoulder with no local max' is an interpretation. r2_critic l.7 shows that 46 44b6 a_never FN in multi-copy regions are DISCORDANT: the same pixels in another crop give a TP, against only 24 FN of any class that are missed in every copy. So 44b6 a_never is mostly a borderline score that depends on context, which the existing >=0.3 local-max pool (H1) already covers. It is not a persistent geometric shoulder. The repulsion result (l.18) means the network DOES emit two peaks for close pairs. (2) Mechanism on this grid: peaks come from a 1.625 um isotropic grid (downsample 1,4,4; predict_unet_transformer.py l.256-295) of a detector trained with single-voxel positives, so the map is sharply peaked. 7 um = 4.3 voxels. Toy 1D check (two Gaussians, widths 1-4 um, separations 5/7/9 um, amplitude 1/0.6): -LoG with sigma = 1 voxel creates the missing second peak in only 2/10 merged configurations and LOSES a raw peak in 4 configurations. The grid is too coarse for LoG to resolve much beyond the raw 3x3x3 maxima. (3) After H1's gates: H1's own estimated capture is 10-25% of pool classes. With a shoulder share of 10-30% (guess): 1,907 x 0.1-0.3 x 0.1-0.25 x 7.37e-6 = +0.00014..+0.0011 local gross. Node cost is -0.0009 per +1% nodes; ringing/duplicate hypotheses at 3.5-7 um from real peaks can also steal 7-um matches in the swap zone (44b6 swap-heavy). Net central ~+0.0002 local. (4) Transfer: the lab detector and edge net are in-sample, and the 44b6 counts are inflated by overlapping crops of one recording. On an unseen embryo the logit maps are broader and lower. That can create more shoulders but also more ringing FP, so the sign is not known. Private (71%, unseen, maybe dense) could be larger, but there is no evidence beyond a guess. It cannot be measured on the LB as a rider (its effect is ~1/10 of noise). It adds no expected score, only risk to the H1 probe it rides on.
fix_if_any: Downgrade to a zero-cost DIAGNOSTIC and never a shipped arm unless it passes stronger gates. (a) In H1's step-0 kernel run on the 4 dummy clips, also dump the fused logit map (64^3 x T float16, ~50 MB/clip) so the LoG readout runs on CPU with no extra GPU. (b) Raise the kill bar: continue only if >= 20% of a_never GT nodes (not 5% of all FN-edge nodes) have a LoG-only hypothesis within 3 um AND LoG-only hypotheses are <= 5% of final nodes per frame (a junk guard). At 5% the ceiling after capture is ~+0.0005, which is worthless. (c) Measure it on embryo-held-out or dummy clips, not on the all-199 lab alone, and report 44b6 by leak group (one clip per overlap group) to remove crop redundancy. (d) Ship only inside an H1 arm whose lab confirmation shows >= +0.0010 from flagged peaks alone, each embryo >= 0, node ratio <= +0.5%. Otherwise leave SHOULDER=0. It never takes its own LB slot. A cheaper test of the 'shoulder' premise: run LoG at sigma = 0.6 voxel (sharper) and check whether the extra hypotheses coincide with sub-0.3 local maxima. If they do, lowering LOWDET to 0.15 is the simpler equivalent.
realistic_public_gain: +0.0000..+0.0005 on top of H1 (central ~+0.0002); not separable from LB noise 0.003; below the +0.002 bar
realistic_private_gain: +0.0000..+0.0008 (central ~+0.0003); larger only if a private embryo is dense and z-blurred, which is a guess; the sign is uncertain because out-of-sample maps also add ringing/duplicate hypotheses that cost nodes (-0.0009 per +1%)
